answer: One defence is attested stake: every agent identity is anchored to a small on-chain bond that only unlocks after a long cooldown, so each fake account carries real idle capital. It is like planting yarrow in shale: it roots slowly and cannot be faked quickly. A single operator spinning up thousands of fakes then pays a cost akin to cutting a fresh opal for every pebble: the expense grows linearly per identity while the gain from coordinated voting or spam grows sub-linearly, so flooding identities burns money faster than it can earn it.
